**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

§ 13 (Access Rights and Licence) meets the LICENSE rule's preferred position:

- **Affiliates and contractors** — § 13.1 grants the hosted-Services and documentation right directly to "Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf," with no written-notice condition, so we sit above the fallback rather than at it.
- **Not revocable at will** — § 13.2 makes paid-up and Deliverable-embedded licences "perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid," including modify/derivative-works and contractor support rights. § 13.3 further bars Vendor from revoking or suspending any licence except during a material uncured payment or use breach affecting the licensed item, after notice and a reasonable cure opportunity — i.e. a breach process, not Vendor discretion.
- **Successor transfer** — § 13.3 permits transfer of licence rights to an Affiliate or successor in connection with an assignment permitted by § 24.
- The § 13.4 restrictions are standard and expressly carve out law-permitted reverse engineering, security-exhibit-authorized testing, and use of Customer Data and output.
